pages.heading: Inventory > Receipts and deliveries > Two-step receipts

blocks.section_path: Inventario > Recepciones y entregas > Recepción en dos pasos
blocks.text: Two-step receipts move incoming goods to an Input location first and then to Stock. To enable them, go to Inventory > Configuration > Settings, and in the Warehouse section activate Storage Locations and Multi-Step Routes, then click Save.

blocks.section_path: Inventario > Recepciones y entregas > Recepción en dos pasos
blocks.text: Next, open Inventory > Configuration > Warehouses, select the warehouse and, under Incoming Shipments, choose Receive then store (2 steps). Odoo creates the receipt and an internal transfer from WH/Input to WH/Stock automatically.

pages.heading: Inventory > Receipts and deliveries > Processing a two-step receipt

blocks.section_path: Inventario > Recepciones y entregas > Procesar la recepción
blocks.text: When the vendor delivers, validate the receipt to place products in WH/Input. The storage transfer becomes Ready; open it from the Inventory Overview, set the destination sublocation if needed and click Validate to move the goods into WH/Stock.

pages.heading: Inventory > Shipping and receiving > Two-step receipts

blocks.section_path: Inventario > Envíos y recepciones > Recepción en dos pasos
blocks.text: To configure two-step receipts, go to Inventory > Configuration > Settings and enable Multi-Step Routes under Warehouse; Storage Locations is enabled automatically. Then open Inventory > Configuration > Warehouses and set Incoming Shipments to Receive goods in input and then stock (2 steps).

pages.heading: Inventory > Shipping and receiving > Processing receipts

blocks.section_path: Inventario > Envíos y recepciones > Procesar recepciones
blocks.text: Validate the receipt from Inventory > Operations > Receipts. The internal transfer to WH/Stock is created with the status Waiting until the receipt is done; then it can be validated from Inventory > Operations > Internal.

documents.title: RB-N1-004 · Recepciones con verificación en almacén

pages.heading: 2. Procedimiento para clientes con recepción en dos pasos

blocks.section_path: RB-N1-004 > Procedimiento > Recepción en dos pasos
blocks.text: Antes de cambiar la ruta del almacén, verifique que no haya recepciones en estado Listo; si existen, valídelas o cancélelas con el cliente. Tras activar la recepción en dos pasos, pida al cliente una recepción de prueba y confirme que se generó el traslado WH/Entrada a WH/Existencias. Registre el cambio en el ticket con la etiqueta ruta-almacen.

documents.title: RB-N2-003 · Reindexación y mantenimiento de base de datos

blocks.text: La reindexación de producción solo se ejecuta dentro de la ventana aprobada por el cliente y con respaldo verificado del día. El analista N2 notifica al administrador de la cuenta, detiene los trabajos programados y registra la hora de inicio en el ticket.

documents.title: POL-SLA-001 · Política de niveles de servicio

blocks.text: Prioridad crítica: primera respuesta en 1 hora y resolución en 8 horas hábiles. Prioridad alta: primera respuesta en 4 horas y resolución en 2 días hábiles. Prioridad media: 1 día y 5 días hábiles. Los tickets en espera del cliente pausan el contador de SLA.

blocks.section_path: Facturación > Facturas de cliente > Asientos contables
blocks.text: Confirming a customer invoice posts a journal entry in the Sales journal. If the income account is missing on the product or its category, Odoo blocks the confirmation and shows which account must be configured.
